build.note: the modules commit (on modules main) and each module's wasm SHA-256, committed under amendment A1 before the first score; the steps refuse to run without it

M.rows: every day the fit and the three prediction days need

O.rows: dated before the UTC day of E; F10.7a over the days of its window at or before the last row

spaceWeather.license: GFZ Kp/ap/Ap/F10.7: CC BY 4.0, Matzka et al. (2021), doi:10.5880/Kp.0001

dca.license: derived aggregate of Planet Labs PBC ephemerides, CC BY-NC 4.0; Planet states and arcs stay local

L1.name: LEO laser-ranged spheres from ILRS normal points
L1.fitInput: the 24 h before T at 60 s, propagator/ffm carried from E6's variant R state at T with E6's forces and the target's E6 B and AGOM (B2's track); XP is not fitted to the ranges

L2.name: LEO laser-ranged satellites from precise orbits
L2.fitInput: the truth's own 24 h at its spacing (B1's block)

I.name: ISS from NASA trajectory files
I.fitInput: file k's first 24 h at 240 s

fit.method: propagator/sdn-ap fit, THEORY SGP4XP, FIT at its defaults, the fit interval declared (USEABLE_START_TIME the first state, USEABLE_STOP_TIME = E)
fit.epoch: the first state of the fit interval (the module's placement)
fit.propagate: propagator/sdn-ap propagate with the arm's $PCF and inputs, explicit truth epochs, TEME; foundation/frames to the truth's axes

public.selection: the newest Space-Track set before E (experiments/e4-operator-ephemeris-parity products.mjs setAt), SGP4 in propagator/sdn-ap

verdict.rule: improves accuracy: the cluster-bootstrap 95 % interval of the day-3 median paired ratio arm/A0 lies wholly below 1, and the same interval at day 1 does not lie wholly above 1; otherwise no demonstrated improvement

D-np.notRun: propagator/sdn-ap fit takes ephemerides; analysis/estimation fit_batch needs a state-and-transition-matrix provider, and none exists for XP

diagnostic.publicBterm: 2 BSTAR / 0.15696615 (m^2/kg; SGP4's reference density rho0 in kg m^-2 per Earth radius)
